watch.summary: A streamer wonders if he has become immune to fall damage right before his character hits the ground and instantly dies.

beats.what: Streamer asks what happened as his character falls from a huge height.
He dramatically ponders if he has become too strong to die from fall damage.
The character hits the ground and dies instantly with a loud crunch, cutting to black.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Have I become so strong I can't die to fall damage anymore?
watch.why: The clip features perfect comedic timing as the creator's pretentious question is instantly answered by a fatal splat. The suddenness of the death right as he finishes his sentence makes it universally funny.
